VBO:0200052.summary: The American Lo-Sze Pugg is a named Pug-type dog. Its published description calls for a low, stocky body, short muzzle and tail carried over the back.
VBO:0200052.shortDescription: A Pug-type dog described with a low, stocky body, short muzzle and tail carried over its back.

sources.title: Dog Breed Info — American Lo-Sze Pugg description and Rebecca Manns example
sources.evidence: Fresh actual description read: long stocky body, short legs, very short broad muzzle, high tail carried over back. Original named Manns Shui Lien Hua photograph credited to Rebecca Manns corroborates exact named Pug-type morphology. Published-description wording is intentionally attributed; photo credit does not establish authorship of surrounding history. Ancient continuity, reconstruction success, dates, legal trademark status, health advice and temperament excluded.

sources.title: IPDBA — Article 3, Recognition of Breeds for Registration
sources.evidence: New direct registry rules read. Section 5 explicitly lists American Lo-Sze Pugg separately from Pug under General Domestic Dog Registration. Section 3 says registration only provides facilities for development, distinct from championship recognition. Used to corroborate named domestic identity, not major-kennel recognition or historical continuity.
